definition: The workhorse off-policy algorithm for continuous control, maximizing reward plus policy entropy so exploration is built into the objective.
details: The workhorse off-policy algorithm for continuous control, maximizing reward plus policy entropy so exploration is built into the objective. Together with its deterministic relatives (DDPG, TD3), it defines the robotics and control side of deep RL that predates and parallels the LLM era.

explainer.lead: Soft Actor-Critic is the workhorse off-policy algorithm for continuous control, maximizing reward plus policy entropy so exploration is built into the objective. It matters because it defines the robotics and control side of deep RL that predates and parallels the LLM era.

tiers.eli5: It's a way for a robot to learn actions that earn reward while also staying curious and trying new things.
tiers.practitioner: It is used for continuous control alongside deterministic relatives DDPG and TD3; exploration comes from the entropy term rather than from an add-on.
tiers.paperLevel: Off-policy algorithm whose objective is reward plus policy entropy, making exploration part of the optimization objective itself.

explainer.example: A continuous-control policy trained with SAC earns reward while its entropy term keeps it exploring.
